whisper.label: Whisper Large-V3
whisper.text:
Hi, my name is Evan Voble and this is my piece Parallax. The piece consists of tiny glass beads
that are coating the interior of this hemisphere that reflect all of the light back to the light
source creating a holographic sphere of light with the spectrum on the edge. My interest in
light comes from all of our perception of reality being constructed out of light and
my main material is glass which is one of the best ways to manipulate light. With this piece
it creates a holographic projection that's only really visible with binocular vision so it's it's
really meant to be experienced in person and it's extremely difficult to capture in video
or photographs. It sort of has to do with phenomenology, experiential,
like perception of light and optics and color. This comes from a whole series of work that has
to do with with light and optics and basically anything that challenges our preconceived notions
of visual perception. So it focuses on sort of the discrepancy between our Phaneron or reality
as filtered through our senses and any sort of objective perception of reality to sort of call
attention to the mechanisms that allow us to perceive the light.
and space.
